description: Update a motion's summary, body, priority, or plan. All fields are optional — only include the ones you want to change. For plan updates, provide the full list of steps (use get_motion first to see the current plan, then modify and send it back). A plan with groups cannot be written here: ask Monnet with ask_monnet instead.

body.description: New body in markdown (1-50,000 chars). Optional.

motion_short_id.description: The first 8 characters of the motion UUID.

plan.description: Full replacement plan — array of step objects. Each step: {content, status, assignees?, approval?, approved_by?}. Optional.

name: update_motion
